panels.title: Throughput

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time, sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket) WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
  AND timestamp < toStartOfInterval(now(), toIntervalSecond($bucket))
GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.description: Total flow-reported traffic rate across the selected scope. Sanity anchor for everything below: if this is near zero, check the Collection Health dashboard before reading any top-10 ranking.

panels.title: Volume (time range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(bytes) AS total FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality)

panels.description: Total bytes carried by flows in the selected range and scope. Switch Tenant/Zone/Locality to compare slices; the top-10 panels below explain who moved it.

panels.title: Flow records (time range)

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS flows FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality)

panels.description: Number of flow records behind these panels — a confidence indicator, not a traffic measure. Low counts (sampled exporters, short ranges) make the rankings noisy; widen the range before trusting close calls.

panels.title: Top 10 Source AS

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT srcAs AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(srcAs IN (SELECT dim FROM top), concat(toString(srcAs), ': ', ifNull(srcAsOrg, 'unknown')), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Traffic rate by originating autonomous system — top 10 by volume, remainder stacked as the grey Other band. A new entrant or a suddenly growing AS is a traffic source worth explaining.

panels.title: Top 10 Destination AS

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT dstAs AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(dstAs IN (SELECT dim FROM top), concat(toString(dstAs), ': ', ifNull(dstAsOrg, 'unknown')), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Traffic rate by destination autonomous system — top 10 by volume, remainder stacked as the grey Other band. Where does our traffic go; sudden shifts point at CDN moves, new services, or exfiltration.

panels.title: Top 10 Talkers (source hosts)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT srcAddr AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(srcAddr IN (SELECT dim FROM top), ifNull(srcAddrHostname, replaceOne(toString(srcAddr), '::ffff:', '')), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Traffic rate by source host, reverse-DNS name where resolved, plain address otherwise. A single host dominating the stack is the first suspect for link saturation — open it in Host Investigation (dashboards menu).

panels.title: Top 10 Destinations (destination hosts)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT dstAddr AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,

       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND

panels.description: Traffic rate by destination host, reverse-DNS name where resolved, plain address otherwise. A single sink drawing outsized volume — backup target, update server, or data sink worth verifying — stands out here.

panels.title: Top 10 Applications

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT ifNull(application, 'unclassified') AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(ifNull(application, 'unclassified') IN (SELECT dim FROM top), ifNull(application, 'unclassified'), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Traffic rate by classified application; 'unclassified' means no classification rule matched. Normal: unclassified stays a small share — a growing unclassified band means the rule set needs attention, not the network.

panels.title: Top 10 Services (protocol/destination port)

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT concat(transform(protocol, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(protocol))), '/', toString(dstPort)) AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(concat(transform(protocol, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(protocol))), '/', toString(dstPort)) IN (SELECT dim FROM top), concat(transform(protocol, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(protocol))), '/', toString(dstPort)), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Traffic rate by protocol/destination-port pair — the port-level view for when application classification is too coarse. Unexpected high-volume ports are the lead to chase in Conversations.

panels.title: Top 10 Protocols

WITH top AS (SELECT transform(protocol, [1, 2, 6, 17, 41, 47, 50, 51, 58, 89, 132], ['ICMP', 'IGMP', 'TCP', 'UDP', 'IPv6', 'GRE', 'ESP', 'AH', 'IPv6-ICMP', 'OSPFIGP', 'SCTP'], concat('proto-', toString(protocol))) AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,

       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series

panels.description: Traffic rate by IP protocol. Normal: TCP and UDP dominate; a visible share of anything else (GRE, ESP, ICMP) deserves an explanation — tunnels, VPNs, or something probing.

panels.description: Traffic rate by exporting device — which vantage points see the traffic. An exporter's band fading while others hold steady may be a collection problem, not a traffic change: check Collection Health.

panels.title: Top 10 Ingress Interfaces

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT concat(exporterAddr, ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp))), if(inputSnmpIfAlias IS NULL, '', concat(' (', inputSnmpIfAlias, ')'))) AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10)
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       if(concat(exporterAddr, ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp))), if(inputSnmpIfAlias IS NULL, '', concat(' (', inputSnmpIfAlias, ')'))) IN (SELECT dim FROM top), concat(exporterAddr, ' - ', ifNull(inputSnmpIfName, concat('if', toString(inputSnmp))), if(inputSnmpIfAlias IS NULL, '', concat(' (', inputSnmpIfAlias, ')'))), 'Other') AS series,
       sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps
FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND
GROUP BY time, series
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Traffic rate by exporter ingress interface — which links carry the load into the monitored network. Read together with Top 10 Exporters to localise a saturating link.

panels.title: Top 10 Source AS - statistics

targets.rawSql:
WITH top AS (SELECT srcAs AS dim FROM ${database}.flows WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) GROUP BY dim ORDER BY sum(bytes) DESC LIMIT 10),
     intDiv(toUnixTimestamp($__toTime), $bucket)
       - intDiv(toUnixTimestamp($__fromTime) + $bucket - 1, $bucket) + 1 AS nBuckets,
     arrayResize(groupArray(bps), greatest(nBuckets, length(groupArray(bps))), 0.) AS padded
SELECT series AS "Src AS",
       arrayMin(padded) AS "Min", arrayMax(padded) AS "Max", argMax(bps, time) AS "Last",
       arrayAvg(padded) AS "Average", arrayReduce('quantile(0.95)', padded) AS "95th",
       sum(bucket_bytes) AS "Total"
FROM (
    SELECT timestamp AS time, concat(toString(srcAs), ': ', ifNull(srcAsOrg, 'unknown')) AS series,
           sum(bytes) * 8 / $bucket AS bps, sum(bytes) AS bucket_bytes
    FROM ${database}.samples(ival = $bucket)
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND $__conditionalAll(tenant IN (${tenant:singlequote}), $tenant) AND $__conditionalAll(zone IN (${zone:singlequote}), $zone) AND $__conditionalAll(flowLocality = '$locality', $locality) AND lastSwitched >= $__fromTime AND deltaSwitched <= $__toTime + INTERVAL $bucket SECOND AND srcAs IN (SELECT dim FROM top)
      AND timestamp < toStartOfInterval(now(), toIntervalSecond($bucket))
    GROUP BY time, series
)
GROUP BY series
ORDER BY "Average" DESC

panels.description: Ranked source-AS table for the range: total volume plus the 95th-percentile rate — the number used for billing and capacity comparisons, deliberately insensitive to short bursts.

description: Which ASes, hosts, applications and services dominate traffic over the selected range? Fleet-compare view over the flows table (byte-weighted, bucketed via the samples view and the Bucket variable); every rate panel stacks the top 10 plus an 'Other' remainder. Scope with Tenant/Zone/Locality; drill into a host via the Host Investigation dashboard (dashboards menu, filters and time carried over).
